Guide the developers: they build new features, test on real devices and work with the stakeholders. Keep the trackers (GitHub Projects) current and report status every week. You have Real production experience as a full-stack engineer, and experience as a lead of a small team. Strong Python and TypeScript. Working knowledge of Flutter and SQL (PostgreSQL). You explain technical trade-offs to people who are not engineers. Good to have Frappe or ERPNext, Supabase, Telnyx or other telephony APIs. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, DSP Tech
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems
* Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed
* Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together

• Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices
  

* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities
* Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services
* Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability
* Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions

  
A day in the life  
You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries.  
  
About the team  
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Business Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
**About TruKKer and the Role**

TruKKer is hiring a Business Solutions Engineer who owns the full journey from a business problem to a solution people actually use, building with Claude Code on top of our existing systems.

TruKKer is a technology-driven road freight and logistics company. Our business teams run on fast-moving, process-heavy workflows, and many of their pain points are best solved by small, well-targeted software rather than long project cycles.

The Business Solutions Engineer sits inside that gap: one person, embedded with the business, who can understand a problem, decide what to build, build it, prove it works, roll it out and keep it useful. There are no hand-offs between a business analyst, a product manager, a developer and a tester.

  

**The Business Solutions Engineer is all of them for the solutions they own.**

  

If you prefer working from requirements someone else has already

written, this is not the role. If you would rather spend a morning with an operations team, find where hours are leaking every week, and have something working in front of them soon after, read on.

  

**Role Summary**

* Research the product space: how similar problems are solved elsewhere, and whether to enhance an existing system or build something new.

**Role & responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Management**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI/ML-powered products and features.
* Translate business problems and customer needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle: discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives) and manage execution using **Jira, Confluence, and similar tools**.
* Balance and manage multiple concurrent product workstreams/portfolios, prioritizing across competing stakeholder demands.
* Define and track success metrics/KPIs (model performance, adoption, latency, cost-per-inference, business impact).
* Partner cross-functionally with engineering, data science, design, legal/compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate roadmap, progress, and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders.
* **Hands-On Technical / AI-ML**
* Directly contribute to prototyping, fine-tuning, evaluating, and iterating on LLMs and other ML models (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, embeddings).
* Collaborate closely with engineers/data scientists on data pipelines, model architecture trade-offs, and deployment strategy (MLOps).
* Evaluate build-vs-buy decisions for foundation models, vector databases, and AI infrastructure tooling.
* Stay current on the AI/LLM landscape (new model releases, techniques, regulatory/ethical considerations) and translate emerging capabilities into product opportunities.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* **Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) or B.Tech** Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related discipline.
* **5 to 7 years of total professional experience**, including 3 years **in Product Management** (AI/ML or data-driven products preferred).
* Demonstrated **hands-on experience building, fine-tuning, or deploying LLMs** not just managing engineers who do so (e.g., portfolio, GitHub, published work, or specific project examples).
* Practical knowledge of **Python** and common ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face) or LLM tooling (Google ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector DBs).
* Proven experience managing **multiple products/workstreams simultaneously** in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with product/project management and collaboration tools: **Jira, Confluence**, or equivalents.
* Strong grasp of agile/scrum methodologies and experience running cross-functional agile teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, written, and verbal communication skills able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences and vice versa.

  

**Perks and benefits**

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Domain experience in automotive, mobility, or manufacturing industries is an added advantage.**
* Solid understanding of NLP concepts, model evaluation metrics, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures is an added advantage.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices — bias mitigation, model governance, data privacy, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI).
* Certifications in Product Management (CSPO, PMP) and/or **AI/ML certifications** are an added advantage.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Shipped AI/LLM-powered features that measurably improve user outcomes and business KPIs.
* A well-managed, transparent roadmap and backlog across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Strong trust from both business stakeholders (for product judgment) and technical teams (for technical credibility).
* Continuous improvement of model quality metrics through direct hands-on involvement, not just delegation.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded **Product Manager** for AI & Agentic Products to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-driven product portfolio.

In this role, you will serve as the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens—determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define what success looks like for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience in Product Management, including defining Product Vision and owning the Product Roadmap
* Expertise in Agile or SAFe frameworks, with extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments
* Understanding of AI Solutions, AI Content Framework, and AI Risk Management
* Knowledge of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
* Familiarity with function calling and multi-agent orchestration concepts (no coding required, but strong conceptual grasp is essential)
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the ROI of automation features
* Capability to manage product lifecycles for non-deterministic software where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable
* Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Showcase of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases using an MVP approach
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager for data science, machine learning, or generative AI products
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in modern **JavaScript**, **TypeScript**, **Node.js**, and cloud technologies, with a strong understanding of frontend architecture, backend services, application security, performance optimization, and software design principles.

As a Lead Developer, you will play a key role in designing technical solutions, mentoring team members, driving architectural decisions, implementing best practices, and delivering high-quality, secure, and maintainable applications.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain server-side applications using Node.js and NestJS, writing reusable, testable, scalable, and efficient backend code
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs for frontend services and third-party integrations
* Build secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT and role-based access control

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of professional software development experience
* Proven experience building large-scale applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js

* Background in application architecture and performance optimization
* Skills in testing and cloud deployments
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: Engineering Project Manager
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, we believe hard work, a vibrant working environment, creativity, and innovation are the forces that drive an exceptional customer experience. We treat every customer interaction as an opportunity to delight, engage, and inspire, knowing that obsessing over the smallest details creates the largest impact. Our Customer Systems organization is not just another team: we are a motivated, fast-paced, ever-evolving and closely knit group that builds ultra-fast, thoughtfully designed, carefully crafted solutions, and we are always looking to scale new heights.
  
  
Description
  
  
We are now seeking a passionate Engineering Program Manager to lead and deliver complex programs across our Customer Experience Engineering team. The role sits at the intersection of technology leadership and operational excellence, owning the full lifecycle of initiatives spanning our enterprise contact centre stack and managing technology programs across the applications and products that power Customer Experience engineering. The ideal candidate brings domain expertise in technical program management within a highly cross-functional, multi-faceted business organisation, a strong understanding of the evolving customer service and systems interaction paradigm, and the discipline to drive multi-workstream initiatives across business units. You are a critical problem solver with a genuine passion for user experience and process excellence, comfortable with cutting-edge technologies, and able to articulate complex technical challenges clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You will own the entire lifecycle of large-scale projects delivered across CXE team areas. You will be in the driver's seat throughout, from business requirements analysis and technical design discussions covering API contracts, data models, and integration patterns, through to testing and partner collaboration. This is not about checking tasks off a list; it is about your ability to lead and deliver on every aspect of the program. You will employ innovative techniques and work collaboratively with team members and business stakeholders across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, deployment, testing, and maintenance. You will partner with world-class engineers and cross-functional teams to identify bottlenecks, instrument and analyse systems for performance and reliability, and deliver scalable, intuitive solutions that elevate how customers connect with Apple. Beyond delivery, you will become the product champion, managing product evolution and defining and owning a multi-year product roadmap that shapes where these platforms go next.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 10+ years of technical program/project management experience delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programs with cross-functional teams on time and within scope.
* Proficiency in Agile (Scrum/Kanban), waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies with tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
* Command of program governance frameworks: dependency mapping, risk registers, change management, and stakeholder engagement plans.
* Proven ability to lead and influence engineering teams, product owners, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, and organisational skills, tailoring messaging from engineering detail to executive summary with a collaborative ownership mindset.
* Strong architectural knowledge to understand delivered solutions and represent the team independently in business conversations.
* Hands-on software development and operations skills (source control, debugging, testing, deployment, monitoring) to rally a team through incident and release management.
* Self-motivated and analytical, comfortable managing vendors and SOW negotiations across multiple concurrent global programs in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Good understanding of GenAI tools usage in all phases of SDLC & be able to apply to Project/ProgramManagement.
* Experience working in a cross-functional, time-zone distributed team environment.
* Ability to read and reason about system architectures, API contracts (REST/SOAP), data flows, and configuration schemas — sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams, challenge technical estimates, and assess risks.
* Experience partnering with Quality, Compliance, and Legal teams on initiatives involving GDPR, accessibility, and related standards.
* Experience working with vendors and contractors.
* Engineering/Technical background preferred.

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

* Build and integrate AWS based services including compute storage and data pipelines to enable robust cloud native processing of geospatial and tabular data.
* Create and maintain data ingestion and transformation workflows that move geospatial and related data into Snowflake for analytics and reporting use cases.
* Develop reusable services and interfaces that connect core applications with GenAI and LLM platforms to enable intelligent querying summarization and recommendation on spatial datasets.

* Value prior exposure to agile delivery environments where work is planned in iterations with regular refinement reviews and adaptation to stakeholder feedback.

jobs.description:
### **Summary**

Location: Hyderabad, India #LI-Hybrid
  
  
Internal job title: Senior Specialist, DDIT PO&CF Knowledge Management
  
  
About the Role:
  
The Senior Semantic Data & Knowledge Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise knowledge structures, ontologies, semantic assets, metadata frameworks, knowledge graphs, and business glossaries that support Analytics, AI, GenAI, Semantic Search, and Agentic AI use cases across P&O and Corporate Functions.
  
The role will focus on translating enterprise business knowledge into reusable semantic assets that enable discoverability, governance, contextual intelligence, and AI-driven decision support.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Knowledge Modelling & Semantic Design**: Develop and maintain ontologies, taxonomies, semantic models, and business glossaries; Define relationships between business concepts, policies, controls, processes, and data assets; Build and maintain enterprise knowledge graphs and semantic repositories; Translate business knowledge into AI-ready semantic structures; Support standardization of enterprise business terminology.
* **Metadata Management & Governance:** Support metadata onboarding, stewardship, governance, and quality initiatives; Maintain metadata repositories and catalog assets; Support business glossary development and governance processes; Collaborate with data stewards, domain owners, and governance teams; Ensure metadata standards and quality requirements are met.
* **Semantic Layer Implementation:** Support implementation and maintenance of Semantic Layer capabilities; Configure and maintain semantic models and business mappings; support onboarding of business domains and enterprise data products; Ensure consistency between source systems and semantic representations.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

ServiceNow CRM helps companies sell, fulfil, and service customers on one AI-powered platform, spanning Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, and Sales CRM.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build features across CRM Self-service and customer service workflows, including case and work order management and guided agent experiences.

jobs.description:
AWS Engineer – UKI SAPDecomEnabler  
Role Purpose  
We are looking for an experienced AWS Engineer to join the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad, supporting Centrica's technology transformation and SAP decommissioning programme.  
The engineer will be responsible for designing, building, automating and supporting secure and scalable AWS based solutions that enable the migration, integration, archival and decommissioning of legacy SAP related workloads and associated services.  
The role requires strong hands on AWS engineering capability combined with Infrastructure as Code, DevOps automation, integration and operational support experience. The successful candidate will work within a cross functional Agile squad alongside architects, application engineers, SAP teams, security, infrastructure, product and business stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities  
AWS Engineering & Cloud Solutions  
  
. Design, build and maintain secure, resilient and scalable solutions on AWS.  
. Develop AWS infrastructure and services supporting application migration and SAP decommissioning activities.  
. Build cloud native and serverless solutions using appropriate AWS managed services.  
. Configure and manage services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, EC2, ECS, IAM, CloudWatch, EventBridge, SNS/SQS and related AWS services.  
. Design solutions considering availability, scalability, performance, security and cost optimisation.  
. Support the migration and transition of workloads and integrations away from legacy platforms into strategic cloud services.  
  
SAP Decommissioning Enablement  
  
. Work with SAP, application and architecture teams to understand legacy SAP dependencies, interfaces and downstream systems.  
. Enable technical solutions required to progressively decouple applications and services from legacy SAP platforms.  
. Support migration, extraction, archival and integration requirements associated with SAP system decommissioning.  
. Identify and resolve application, infrastructure and integration dependencies that could impact decommissioning.  
. Ensure replacement AWS services meet agreed functional and non functional requirements before legacy components are retired.  
. Support technical cutover, validation, hypercare and controlled retirement of legacy services.  
  
Infrastructure as Code & Automation  
  
. Build and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.  
. Automate environment provisioning, configuration and deployment wherever possible.  
. Develop reusable infrastructure modules and patterns aligned with Centrica engineering standards.  
. Reduce manual operational activities through scripting and automation using Python, Bash and/or Node.js/TypeScript.  
  
DevOps & CI/CD  
  
. Build, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.  
. Work with Git/GitHub and modern continuous integration and deployment practices.  
. Implement automated build, testing, security scanning and deployment controls.  
. Promote repeatable, auditable and low risk deployment processes across environments.  
. Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering and DevOps practices within the squad.  
  
Integration & Data  
  
. Design and support integrations between AWS services, enterprise applications and legacy/SAP platforms.  
. Develop and consume REST APIs and event driven interfaces.  
. Work with asynchronous messaging and event driven architecture patterns where appropriate.  
. Support secure movement, transformation and storage of data required during migration and decommissioning.  
. Collaborate with data and SAP teams to ensure data retention, archival and access requirements are addressed.  
  
Security, Monitoring & Operational Resilience  
  
. Implement AWS security best practices covering IAM, encryption, secrets management, network security and least privilege access.  
. Ensure solutions comply with Centrica security, data protection and technology standards.  
. Implement logging, monitoring, dashboards and alerting using AWS CloudWatch and enterprise monitoring tools.  
. Proactively identify reliability and performance issues.  
. Participate in incident investigation, root cause analysis and problem resolution.  
. Ensure appropriate operational documentation, runbooks and support procedures are maintained.  
  
Agile & Stakeholder Collaboration

IDrive is a leading provider of secure and scalable cloud backup, S3-compatible object storage, and remote access solutions. Trusted by over 5 million users worldwide, we empower individuals and businesses to protect, access, and manage their data with high-performance tools built for speed, reliability, and security.

  

**About the Job**

As a **Technical Manager for IDrive BMR (Bare Metal Restore)**, you will lead the team in advancing our Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery platform, improving backup, recovery, and cloud integration while driving reliability, scalability, and performance across on-premises and cloud environments.

  

**What you will be doing:**

  

Technical oversight & execution

* Oversee the architecture and development of BMRs core platform (ZFS-based storage, backup orchestration, recovery automation).
* Define and execute the technical roadmap for next-gen BCDR capabilities, including AI-driven insights, smart retention, and hybrid cloud recovery.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver enterprise-grade reliability and seamless user experiences.

Team & project leadership

* Lead and coordinate multiple engineering teams (Java, Python, C++, and frontend) to ensure timely, high-quality releases.
* Collaborate with the Director of Engineering and Product Owner to align on goals, priorities, and technical direction.
* Oversee the complete product lifecycle from architecture and planning to QA, deployment, and maintenance.
* Drive collaboration across backend, frontend, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure efficient communication and delivery.

Core technologies youll work with

* Server OS: Debian 12
* Programming languages: Java, Python, C++, ReactJS
* Storage layer: ZFS
* Virtualization targets: Hyper-V, VMware
* Backup targets: Windows endpoints
* Architecture: Multi-service backend with a web-based management console

Process & collaboration

* Engineering & Delivery Management: Direct multi-disciplinary engineering teams (15+ engineers) delivering high-performance backup and restore software
* Agile Execution & Tooling: Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and team velocity using JIRA; foster an Agile/Scrum environment to ensure predictable, high-quality deliverables.

* Security & System Reliability: Embed application security best practices into the SDLC, focusing on secure data handling, encryption, and system hardening.

  

**What we expect from you:**

  

Experience & technical expertise

* 10 to 15 years of software development experience, including 46 years in technical or engineering management roles.
* Proven track record of leading multiple teams and technical leads, managing 20+ engineers.
* Strong proficiency in Java, Python, C++, and web-based architectures.
* Hands-on understanding of Linux environments (Debian preferred), file systems, and storage technologies (ZFS preferred).
* Excellent communication, collaboration, analytical, and decision-making skills, with the ability to align technical execution with business goals.

Good to have

* Experience managing distributed systems or backup/recovery platforms.
* Familiarity with RESTful API design, service orchestration, and hybrid cloud/on-prem integrations.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, testing automation, and DevOps practices.
* Ability to evaluate, adopt, and integrate emerging technologies into production systems.
* Passion for mentorship, technical leadership, and nurturing engineering talent.
* Knowledge of virtualization platforms (such as VMware and Hyper-V) and disaster recovery systems will be an added advantage.

  

**Why join us?**

  

At IDrive, we’re creating an environment where innovation thrives, talent is recognized, and people are empowered to grow. We are committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally.

  

Here’s what you can look forward to as part of our team:

  

Startup spirit

* Dynamic work culture where ideas are encouraged and innovation is celebrated
* Opportunity to take ownership of projects from concept to completion
* Hands-on exposure to new and emerging technologies
* Collaborative, fast-paced environment that rewards creativity and initiative
* Direct impact — see your work shape real products used by millions
* Room to grow — learn, experiment, and expand your skill set every day

Health & wellness

* Medical insurance with customizable coverage for you and your family
* Comprehensive life and accidental insurance for added peace of mind
* Free annual health check-up to keep your wellbeing on track

Culture & community

* Company events and team lunches to foster connection and collaboration
* Festival gifts and goodies to celebrate special occasions together

Perks that matter

* Competitive pay that reflects your experience and contributions
* Online storage space

Flexible work environment

* Hybrid work model with flexible hours to suit your lifestyle
* Paid time off and holidays to relax and recharge
* Parental leave for life’s important milestones

The ideal candidate has transitioned from a solid technical background (originally as a Software Developer, Tech Lead, or Architect in Java/.NET) into a seasoned delivery leader capable of managing multi-million-dollar portfolios, driving engineering transformations, and mentoring next-generation tech leaders.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and govern the end-to-end delivery of a multi-million-dollar portfolio of enterprise applications built on modern Java and .NET stacks

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operatio…

 Waaree Autonova builds robotics and industrial automation for manufacturing and   
 logistics: autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), warehouse and intralogistics systems, smart

 entry plan for a new segment; the next you might be reviewing a partner contract, setting

---------------

Are you passionate about leveraging evolving LLM technology to solve one of Amazon's most fundamental challenges? Do you want to be building the platform that processes over 5 billion customer interactions annually and transforms months of technical work into minutes? As the Principal Product Manager - Technical (PMT) for the Customer Anecdote Miner [CAM] Platform (winner of the 2024 All Amazon Global Door Desk Award), you'll shape the future of how Amazon teams understand and act on customer feedback at unprecedented scale.  
  
We are looking for a Principal PMT who thrives on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems and turning them into clear product strategies that deliver meaningful results at scale. In this role, you will own a multi-year product vision, shape technology investments, and drive cross-organizational alignment to launch products that customers love. You will partner closely with engineering, design, science, and business teams to deconstruct complex challenges into elegant solutions — all while keeping the customer at the centre of every decision. If you are a strategic thinker with deep technical curiosity, a talent for influencing without authority, and a track record of delivering products that matter, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own and drive a multi-year product vision and strategic roadmap, setting direction in ambiguous spaces where the problem, opportunity, and strategy may not yet be defined.

* Partner as a technical peer with engineering, applied science, and design teams to evaluate architecture proposals, identify trade-offs others may miss, and ensure solutions are extensible, scalable, and aligned with strategic goals.

* Experience with mobile app security, app store ecosystems, or content moderation platforms.
* Technical familiarity with LLM security evaluation, AI threat models (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), or static/dynamic code analysis tools.
* Strong data-driven mindset with experience defining and optimizing multi-objective platform metrics (safety vs. speed vs. operational cost).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. Mokka is the core review engine that processes every app submission, update, and runtime signal to protect billions of users from security vulnerabilities, policy violations, and malicious behavior.  
  
As the Product Manager for Mokka, you will take the lead on driving the overall strategy and tactical execution of our next-generation review infrastructure. Your core mission is to bridge advanced ML-driven detection capabilities with developer velocity, ensuring our entire ecosystem remains secure without unnecessary friction.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the multi-year product roadmap for Mokka, the app safety review platform, to scale under submission volume increases driven by AI-assisted code generation (vibe coding).
* Architect automated static, dynamic, and LLM-assisted review pipelines that intercept modern security threats before apps reach production. Design robust defenses against emerging AI vulnerabilities, including malicious model weights, indirect prompt injection vectors, agentic permission escalation, and generative privacy leaks.
* Balance friction-free onboarding for legitimate developers with rigorous verification checks for high-risk or automated app factories.
* Partner with Operations and Policy teams to design intelligent human-in-the-loop review interfaces, leveraging generative AI assistants to speed up analyst workflows and reduce manual cognitive load.
* Partner closely with ML Research, Security Engineering, Policy Operations, and Developer Relations across global sites (US, Bangalore, London, Singapore) and drive alignment across vertical AET teams (e.g. Content, Malware)

Interested in being part of a worldwide Advertising Customer Experience team? Then, the Software Development team that builds Tier-1 customer-facing front-end Advertising Experiences wants you!  
  
Advertising is one of the fastest growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Amazon Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost their product reach and sales through performance and display advertising.  
  
The Ads Billing platform is an enabler for Amazon Advertising's worldwide rapid growth and offers a singular platform to manage all of the advertiser-facing functions like billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and the Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) in real-time while being transparent and auditable from the ground up. As a part of this high-energy, entrepreneurial team you will get an opportunity to innovate on solutions that control the very levers of our advertisers' experience and have the satisfaction of seeing your work impact multiple advertising businesses and bring in multi-million transactions worth 100x in dollar value on a daily basis. This platform owns these mandates for worldwide advertising displayed On or Off Amazon.  
  
The Ads Billing team is looking for a Front-End Engineer to build global, scalable, extensible, and secure front-end applications for Billing, Budgeting, Payments, and Promotions Advertiser Experience (AX). These applications have to seamlessly interact with different downstream ad serving platforms, billing and budgeting systems across a broad variety of advertisement programs with no loss in information, and they build the customer-facing experiences that make billing, budgeting, and payments for advertising frictionless. The platform has to guarantee a latency SLA of milliseconds so that the real-time experience of advertisers is never impacted. Beyond raw performance, these are the surfaces advertisers reach for to understand what they owe, why they owe it, and how to act on it — so the work is as much about clarity, usability, and craft as it is about distributed architecture. To build this platform you will need to be well versed in high-performance and distributed front-end architecture, and care deeply about the experience on the other side of the screen.

Distributed and Scalable Front-End Architecture: Looking at advertising's international expansion and business growth plans for next year, we expect this traffic to grow 10X in the near future. Billing and Budgeting front-end systems should scale easily to manage an exponential increase in business and be extensible to support different business needs.

Downtime in Advertiser Experience systems can cause a huge loss in revenue and business opportunity for our advertisers, and is a serious trust buster. A high-availability architecture ensures the system is configured to handle different loads and failures with minimal or no downtime.  
  
Customer Experience and Usability: Billing is where trust is won or lost. Advertisers need to understand complex charges, budgets, and payment states at a glance, across dozens of locales, currencies, and regulatory regimes. The challenge is to turn that complexity into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software — applying proven UI design patterns, meeting Amazon's accessibility bar, and partnering with Product and UX to ship simple, coherent experiences that advertisers find clear, predictable, and easy to act on.  
  
What is Amazon Advertising?
  
Amazon Advertising is a set of tools offered to advertisers — sellers, vendors, authors, publishers, and more — to increase the visibility of their products and services on Amazon, using Cost-per-click (CPC) and Cost-per-impression (CPM) programs. At the scale of Amazon it is extremely important for our advertisers to have the right set of controls to create and boost their advertising presence to gain customers and create long-term value.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You own what you and your team creates.  
  
You work with your team to invent, design, and build software that is stable, performant, secure, and accessibility compliant. You work on feature ideas with customers, designers, product managers, stakeholders, and peers.  
  
You increase the speed of implementation of UX features by identifying and mitigating design risks early.  
  
You view your interface creations from the customer’s point of view.  
  
You start from the advertiser's experience and work backwards — turning complex billing, budgeting, and payment flows into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software, so advertisers can understand what they owe and act on it with confidence.  
  
You bring ideas to the table. You spot opportunities to simplify or reimagine an experience, prototype and propose them, and advocate for the approach that best serves our customers in Product and UX debates.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

RoaDo helps shippers and logistics teams run domestic and cross-border freight on one connected platform. As a Product Manager, you'll take charge of one area of that platform. Depending on business needs at the time you join, it could be load planning, carrier sourcing and spot bidding, shipment visibility, our AI-driven control tower, digital proof of delivery, freight billing, or our export-import (EXIM) workflows. You'll partner with engineers, operations teams, and enterprise clients to turn real logistics problems into products that deliver clear business results.

Your Responsibilities

* Set the product direction and quarterly priorities for your area, and see them through to delivery

* Take full ownership of how users get work done in your module, from first sketch to everyday adoption

* Strengthen how RoaDo connects with the outside world: client ERPs, transporter systems, GPS and telematics devices, shipping lines, forwarders, customs brokers, and port terminals

* Give customers a single view of their international shipments, from factory gate to port, across the sea or air leg, and on to final delivery

* Spend regular time with exporters, importers, transporters, forwarders, and finance teams to find where work breaks down and decide what to fix first

* Write detailed requirement documents that leave little room for interpretation, and stay close to the engineering team through each sprint

* Choose the right success measures, such as usage, turnaround time, port dwell, and cost per shipment, and report on them consistently

What We're Looking For

* 3 to 5 years in product management, including at least 2 years running a B2B software product with full accountability

* Solid knowledge of road freight in India, both full-truckload and part-load, including how loads are planned, how transporters are selected, how trips are tracked, and how freight bills are settled

* Practical understanding of the truckload lifecycle: placing orders with transporters, monitoring trip milestones, handling waiting charges, and closing payments

* Good knowledge of export-import operations, including space booking, container handling at CFS and ICD, port movement, customs filing, and coordination with shipping lines and forwarders

* Comfort with core trade documents and terms such as Bill of Lading, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, Incoterms, and demurrage and detention charges

* Experience with exception alerts, live visibility, or control-tower style products will set you apart

* Able to read API docs and work through integration details with engineers, including GPS and SIM-based tracking, container tracking feeds, webhooks, and ERP connections

* A data-driven mindset: you can estimate the size of a problem, pick the metric that matters, and build a persuasive case from numbers

* Strong written communication and the ability to align engineering and business teams around a spec

How You Use AI

We give real weight to this. RoaDo PMs are expected to use AI as part of their everyday toolkit.

* You regularly use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analyse data and find patterns in product logs, customer tickets, and call notes

* You can quickly build a working prototype or demo to test an idea before engineering time is spent

* You use AI to speed up research, produce first drafts of specs, and challenge your own assumptions early

* You think about how AI can change what our product does for customers, such as reading trade documents automatically or predicting delays, and not only how it speeds up building

Bonus Points

**About CertifyOS**
CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.
  
  
Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.
  
  
Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.
  
  
Our vision is simple:
**One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.**
We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.
  
  
**About The Role**
CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure for the next generation of provider technology. As we scale across Credentialing, Monitoring, Rosters, Provider Network Operations, the biggest bottleneck is no longer just building features - it is making the platform easier for internal teams and customers to configure, operate, and extend safely. As the Senior Technical Product Manager, Data, you will own the strategy and execution for the system that keeps credentialed practitioners continuously compliant with NCQA standards. You'll be accountable for the end-to-end data provisioning experience, the data elements, the quality of that data, and the source veracity that proves historical compliance during audits. The ideal candidate would be comfortable making all provider data pipelines trustworthy, fast, configurable, and cheap to run at scale, while moving the team from a service-driven, manual-review posture toward a productized, self-serve, AI-native one. This role sits at the intersection of platform thinking and technical product expertise. You'll partner closely with the Application Product team, Operations, Implementation and Client Success teams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Sourcing: getting the data

+ Own "detect need" and source routing. Define what triggers a data request (a new file, a monthly monitoring cycle, an expiring element) and the rules that route it to the best source: bulk file, API, scraper, paid vendor, outreach or a human analyst. Every attempt and its raw response is recorded.
+ Own source economics. Know the cost, coverage and latency of every source. Decide when to build a scraper, buy an API or pay for a bulk feed.

* Association: getting it on the right practitioner

+ Own attribution and matching. Define how acquired records are matched to practitioners across identifiers that are often missing or conflicting, including probabilistic matching models. Set the quality bar for false and missed matches, and own the review path for low-confidence results.
+ Own survivorship and Master Data Management governance. Define which source wins for each attribute, and make that configurable. Golden record rules, merge and unmerge, audit trail, and a monitoring and observability loops so matching changes never ship blind.

* Across the chain

+ Build explainability. Anyone in the company should be able to ask why a license is missing, stale or attached to the wrong practitioner, and get a traced answer from source to screen. Partner with engineering on the observability that makes the answer trustworthy.
+ Measure data loss end to end. Build the attribute-level funnel that shows where data drops out between acquisition and the application, and give each application pod a data health metric tied to its own north star.
+ Keep data pipelines stable. Triage pipeline and data escalations, separate one-off fixes from product gaps, and cut the volume of manual re-scrapes and stale-data tickets.
+ Define metrics for data platform effectiveness: Metrics by application and client, source success rate and freshness, % of requests resolved without a human, match precision and recall, % of data errors caught before a client reports them, time to explain a data issue, and external data cost per practitioner.

**Must-Haves**

* AI-native execution. At home and highly productive in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar. You use them to query data, prototype, write specs and automate your own work, and you know where they fail.
* 5 to 8 years of experience, with at least 3 years with technical product management experience with data products or backend products.
* Technical fluency across APIs, data pipelines, retries and orchestration, and third-party data integrations.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of: data acquisition, scraping or ingestion; or entity resolution, record linkage, MDM or identity matching.
* Strong SQL and data literacy: completeness and freshness metrics, data modeling basics, warehouse tooling (BigQuery a plus). You query the data yourself before you form an opinion.
* Experience turning manual operational workflows into product capability, and the judgement to say no to one-off requests.
* Clear written communication. You write specs an engineer and a coding agent can both build from.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience in healthcare technology, provider data management, credentialing, or NCQA/CMS-regulated data environments.
* Experience with rules/flagging engines, exception-review workflows, or compliance audit tooling.
* Experience building AI-assisted internal tools, agentic triage/resolution, or support copilots.
* Familiarity with BigQuery, embedded analytics, or customer-facing compliance reporting.
* Background as an engineer or technical implementation lead before PM.
* Startup/high-growth experience in data platform or US SaaS applications

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**
Security is one of the most critical challenges facing organisations today. Threats are becoming more sophisticated, enterprise environments are increasingly diverse, and AI is rapidly changing both how attacks are carried out and how security products are built and operated.
  
  
Microsoft Security is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of security experiences across endpoint.
  
  
We are looking for a security-first product leader with strong technical depth and experience building enterprise security products. The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as endpoint security, Microsoft Intune, device management or mobile security, along with a strong understanding of how AI is transforming security and product development.
  
  
This role requires more than traditional product management. We are looking for someone who can use AI to fundamentally improve the PM craft, accelerating customer discovery, research, analysis, product definition and prototyping, while applying strong judgement to turn insights into the right product investments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Product Manager, you will:
  
  

* Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap and execution for key endpoint, device and mobile security scenarios.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers, threat trends and emerging security challenges, and translate them into clear product opportunities.
* Partner across engineering, security research, design and product teams to drive clarity, alignment and execution of complex, cross-team security initiatives.
* Define and drive security experiences spanning endpoint protection, detection, investigation and response, device security and mobile protection.
* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve security outcomes, including faster protection, detection, investigation, response and security operations.
* Leverage AI across the product management lifecycle to accelerate customer insights, product analysis, requirements, prototyping and experimentation, enabling faster and higher-quality product decisions.
* Engage directly with enterprise customers, security operations teams and IT administrators to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Make product prioritisation decisions based on security risk, customer impact, product data and business opportunity.
* Define measurable product outcomes and continuously evaluate adoption, effectiveness and customer value.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Significant product management experience delivering complex enterprise or technical products.
* 8 + Yrs of experience in product management
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security products or closely related enterprise security technologies.
* Proven experience taking major product capabilities from customer problem and product strategy through engineering execution, launch and adoption.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, design and security trade-offs.
* Strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into product strategy and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and security operations or IT administration personas.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:
  
  

* Endpoint Security: Deep understanding of endpoint protection, threat detection, and endpoint detection and response across modern enterprise environments.
* Device & Mobile Security: Experience with Microsoft Intune or equivalent device management and security solutions, including mobile device/application management, device compliance, and Android/iOS security.
* Enterprise & Cross-Platform Security: Experience securing diverse environments across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, with a strong understanding of the needs of large enterprise customers, security operations teams, and IT administrators.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in science, Life Sciences, Data Management, or related field.
